title.zh: 相对阻尼率多流体平衡

summary: Convert five explicitly defined scalar rates and declared electron/ion classes into a conservative momentum-exchange equilibrium. This is a declared interpretation, not a claim of equivalence to the ambiguous nu controls.

identity.relation: Physical species deck to cold/gyrotropic fluid equilibrium
identity.definition: For each unordered pair, K_ij=nu_relative*rho_i*rho_j/(rho_i+rho_j). Class-specific bath rates form independent diagonal drag. The two-body relative velocity damps at the declared nu_relative.
identity.model: Multi-species nonrelativistic equilibrium with optional conservative pair momentum exchange and bath drag.
identity.geometry: Uniform field along z; local transverse density gradients may be supplied.
identity.coordinates: Cartesian x,y,z; positive pressure along the declared frame.
identity.boundary: Local Fourier perturbations; no finite-domain boundary solve.
assumptions: Pair exchange K is symmetric, nonnegative and has zero diagonal.
Collision generator acts on velocity perturbations; no inferred source collision-rate interpretation.

Fluid constants profile: c2=(2.9979e8 m/s)^2, epsilon0=8.854e-12 F/m, mu0=1/(c2*epsilon0), gamma default5/3. Charge and mass are explicit SI deck inputs; the defaults use q=+/-1.602e-19 C, me=9.109e-31 kg and mp=1.673e-27 kg. Sound speeds are direct inputs; no kB or temperature-to-speed conversion is performed. This is distinct from current kinetic initialization epsilon0=8.8542e-12 F/m.

inputs.name: deck
inputs.units: C; kg; m^-3; m/s; m/s; m/s; m/s; m/s; m^-1; m^-1
inputs.constraints: Finite; mass and density positive; sound speeds nonnegative. None loads the independent two-species SI deck.

inputs.name: species_classes
inputs.description: Explicit scientific collision class for every species.
inputs.constraints: Each entry is 'electron' or 'ion'; class is not inferred from mass or charge sign.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Uniform signed equilibrium magnetic field along z.
inputs.constraints: Finite; zero-field field-following pressure must be isotropic.

inputs.name: pressure_frame
inputs.constraints: 'field_following' rotates gyrotropic pressure with B; 'fixed_z' freezes its axes and sets magnetic pressure-rotation term to zero.

inputs.name: electron_bath_rate
inputs.description: Electron-class drag against an external stationary bath.
inputs.constraints: Finite nonnegative stationary-bath velocity drag rate; zero disables this channel.

inputs.name: ion_bath_rate
inputs.description: Ion-class drag against an external stationary bath.
inputs.constraints: Finite nonnegative stationary-bath velocity drag rate; zero disables this channel.

inputs.name: electron_pair_relative_rate
inputs.description: Relative velocity damping for each electron/electron pair.
inputs.constraints: Finite nonnegative relative damping rate; zero disables this channel.

inputs.name: ion_pair_relative_rate
inputs.description: Relative velocity damping for each ion/ion pair.
inputs.constraints: Finite nonnegative relative damping rate; zero disables this channel.

inputs.name: electron_ion_relative_rate
inputs.description: Relative velocity damping for each electron/ion pair.
inputs.constraints: Finite nonnegative relative damping rate; zero disables this channel.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Independent equilibrium mapping: q,m,n,v,csz2,csp2,epsnx,epsny,rho,B0,gamma,c2,epsilon0,mu0,Pz,Pp,Delta,pressure_frame,beta_z,beta_p,vA_species,velocity_collision,charge_density,current_density. Also includes exchange, bath_drag, species_classes, collision_contract.
outputs.units: q C; m kg; n m^-3; v m/s; cs^2,c2 m^2/s^2; epsn m^-1; rho kg/m^3; B0 T; gamma,beta dimensionless; epsilon0 F/m; mu0 H/m; P Pa; Delta Pa/T; vA m/s; collision s^-1; charge_density C/m^3; current_density A/m^2; exchange K kg m^-3 s^-1; bath_drag s^-1; species_classes and collision_contract dimensionless labels
outputs.shape: species vectors; v(S,3); velocity_collision(S,S); current_density(3,); exchange(S,S); bath_drag(S,); species_classes tuple of length S; collision_contract scalar string
outputs.dtype: dict of float64 arrays/scalars, str, tuple[str], nullable beta arrays
outputs.constraints: rho=m*n; P=rho*cs^2/gamma. At B0=0 both beta arrays are None and Alfven speeds vanish; neutrality/current balance are reported, not imposed.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
supported: Arbitrary explicitly classified species, including negative ions classified as ions.
Five nonnegative scalar relative/bath rate controls.
excluded: Reinterpreting the nue/nui/nuee/nuii/nuei controls without a physical declaration.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned on failure.

example.description: Declare a relative electron-ion damping rate.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.multifluid import fluid_deck, fluid_equilibrium_relative_rates
s = fluid_equilibrium_relative_rates(fluid_deck(), species_classes=["electron", "ion"], electron_ion_relative_rate=2.0)
assert s["exchange"][0, 1] > 0
example.expected: With electron_ion_relative_rate=2.0, the exchange matrix was symmetric with off-diagonal value about 1.5841035e-23 kg m^-3 s^-1.

scope: Current SciRel implementation and the repository tests listed in this contract cover the declared public ports and numerical relation.
The example exercises one bounded representative case; it does not extend applicability beyond the declared preconditions.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct tests and the bounded example establish only the declared input/output behavior, numerical checks and failure boundaries; they do not establish arbitrary-parameter parity, branch uniqueness, global physical validity, human scientific endorsement or release approval.
known_limitations: Relative-pair and bath rates have different conservation properties.
Rates form a declared scientific variant; positive-rate growth is not reproduced.
Example output is a bounded runtime observation, not a universal scientific claim.

references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).
